_comment: Committed regression baseline for ShadcnReferenceComparisonTest.kt's gate (samples/ui-showcase). Each 'baseline' value is the mismatchPct recorded the last time a maintainer looked at its diff PNG and accepted it -- the test fails if a pair's current mismatchPct exceeds its recorded value by more than tolerancePct. This does NOT gate fidelity to real shadcn/ui (that stays informational, see tools/shadcn_parity_thresholds.json); it gates REGRESSION -- getting worse without anyone deciding that's OK. Regenerate with: ./gradlew :samples:ui-showcase:desktopTest --tests "*ShadcnReferenceComparisonTest*" -DAWAKE_RECORD_SNAPSHOTS=true -- same convention as ShadcnParityScreenshotTest, run without recording first and read the diff PNG before recording (skills/awake-ui-verification/SKILL.md).
_toleranceNote: 1.0 percentage point. Four back-to-back runs on unchanged code produced byte-identical shadcn-parity-metrics.json (0.00pp drift) -- the harness has no measured run-to-run noise on one machine/JVM. 1.0pp is headroom above that measured-zero floor for cross-machine/JDK/font-rendering variance, not a response to observed flakiness. See docs/reference/ui-validation.md's gate section for the live perturbation proof: forcing the checked checkbox's fill red moved checkbox-local-light from 26.32% to 30.77% (+4.45pp, over 4x this tolerance) and the gate failed with that exact message; reverting returned it to exactly 26.32% and the gate passed.

excluded.slider-local-light: docs/reference/shadcn-previews-local/slider-states_light.png is itself only 256x6px before any Awake-side cropping runs -- the reference capture's own bounding box doesn't include the slider thumb (a capture-tool issue in tools/capture_shadcn_local.py / the reference app's Slider wrapper, not an Awake rendering or alignment problem). No aligned-crop tuning on the Kotlin comparison side can make this number mean anything; still rendered and reported (uncapped) so the diff heatmap stays available, just not gated.
